chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Safwan ibn Yahya, who said:

I said to al-Rida عليه السلام: We used to ask you, before Allah had granted Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام to you, and you would say: Allah will grant me a boy. Now Allah has indeed granted him to you, and our eyes have been delighted. May Allah not show us your day; but if an event should occur, then to whom?
So he gestured with his hand toward Abi Ja‘far عليه السلام, while he was standing before him.
So I said: May I be your ransom, this is a son of three years? He said: And what harm is there to him in that? Isa عليه السلام stood with the Divine Proof while he was a son of three years.

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام, identified here as the succeeding Imam
key_terms.الرِّضَا: Imam al-Rida عليه السلام, the one being addressed in the report
key_terms.بِالْحُجَّةِ: with the Divine Proof; bearing divinely granted authority
key_terms.عِيسَى: Isa عليه السلام, cited as a precedent for authority in childhood
key_terms.غُلَامًا: a boy; the promised son granted by Allah
key_terms.يَوْمَكَ: your day; meaning the day of death or passing

ai.seo_question: Can an Imam hold divine authority at a very young age?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms the designation of Imam al-Jawad عليه السلام by Imam al-Rida عليه السلام despite his very young age. It presents age as no obstacle to divine authority, drawing a parallel with Isa عليه السلام, who bore the hujjah while still a child.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Safwan Bin Yahya who said,

‘I said to Al-Reza<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, ‘We had asked you<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> before Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Endowed Abu Ja’far<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> (9<sup style="font-weight: normal">th</sup> Imam<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>) to you<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>. So you<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> were saying: ‘Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> will Endow a boy unto me<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>’. So Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> has (now) Endowed him<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> to you<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> and our eyes are delighted. May Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> not Show us your<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> day (of passing away). So if it does happen, to whom (should we look to)?’

So he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> gestured by his<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> hand towards Abu Ja’far<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, and he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> was standing in front of him<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>’.

So I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>! This is a boy of three years old?’ He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘And nothing affects him<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> from that. Isa<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> had stood with the Divine Authority and he<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> was a boy of three years old’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Safwan ibn Yahya who has said the following.

“Once I said to abu Ja‘far (a.s.), ‘Before Allah would grant you the blessed birth of abu Ja‘far we would ask you the question and you would say that Allah will soon grant you a son. Allah, now, has blessed you with such a favor and may He make him to be the delight for your heart. We wish not to experience a single day without you but, Allah forbid, if something would happen to you from who must we seek guidance?”
He pointed with his hand to abu Ja‘far (a.s.) and he was standing before him.

I then said, “May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, he is only a child of three years old.” He said, “That does not matter in his case at all. Jesus rose with Divine authority when he three years old only.”
